title: Hikers who vanish near the alien bases are killed or kept as workers
place_text: Mount Nyangani, Zimbabwe; Mount Zeil, Australia

tellings.quote: You see too much. You disappear.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant, says there are alien bases near two mountains: Mount Nyangani in Zimbabwe and Mount Zeil in Australia. According to him, hikers who go missing near these places have been killed or kept as workers, and he sums it up as "You see too much. You disappear." If true, it would mean the disappearances people report around these mountains have a hidden, non-human cause.
